scope: Primary-source capability references, not selected or quoted railway equipment. Exact order-line manufacturing origin and compliance require written confirmation.

suppliers.name: Raspberry Pi 5 / Sony Pencoed
suppliers.role: SBC supervisor and logging reference; no PWM or sole support protection
suppliers.origin: UK manufacture documented for Raspberry Pi 5; exact order origin to confirm
suppliers.evidence: Manufacturer describes Raspberry Pi 5 production at Sony UK Technology Centre in Wales.

suppliers.name: Rotary Engineering W10/W20/W30 family
suppliers.role: Factory winding-machine candidates; 4x4 mm compact support conductor and 5x4 mm comparison require specific tooling trials
suppliers.origin: Designed and manufactured in Sheffield per supplier; European-origin motors disclosed
suppliers.evidence: Supplier lists three machine sizes up to 290 Nm, tensioning/guide accessories and UK manufacturing.

suppliers.name: Nidec Drives / Unidrive M700
suppliers.role: Common-DC/linear-motor industrial reference; catalogue voltage does not qualify the 2400 V hypothesis
suppliers.origin: UK manufacturing capability in Newtown; exact drive/configuration origin unconfirmed
suppliers.evidence: Product describes linear-motor control, common DC links and braking; manufacturer documents its Welsh manufacturing facility.

suppliers.name: API Capacitors
suppliers.origin: UK design/manufacturing capability documented; exact capacitor origin requires quote
suppliers.evidence: Manufacturer offers UK custom power-capacitor design and manufacture.

suppliers.name: Cressall
suppliers.role: Custom pulse/repetitive-duty brake resistor and load-bank candidate
suppliers.origin: UK manufacturing capability; exact resistor build and input origins unconfirmed
suppliers.evidence: Manufacturer documents Leicester production and industrial/rail braking-resistor expertise; small ES catalogue units do not establish MW-pulse capability.

suppliers.name: ST STM32G474
suppliers.role: Local current/PWM acquisition MCU reference, Rust no_std kernel target
suppliers.evidence: Manufacturer lists motor-control timers, five 4-MSPS ADCs and seven comparators; these features do not prove OSR timing or protection.

suppliers.name: TI UCC21520
suppliers.role: 96 V support H-bridge dual isolated gate-driver reference
suppliers.evidence: Dual-channel driver with disable and programmable deadtime. Its 4/6 A ratings are gate-drive peaks, not winding current. Do not assume suitability for 3.3 kV main traction modules.

suppliers.name: Infineon 3.3 kV IGBT module class
suppliers.role: Custom high-voltage launch bridge design envelope; exact module and sharing/SOA remain open
suppliers.origin: Imported power semiconductor; exact origin unconfirmed
suppliers.evidence: Product tables establish industrial IGBT families. The FF1200R17IP5 1700 V reference is explicitly unsuitable as a sole two-level switch on a 2400 V bus.

suppliers.name: Micro-Epsilon eddyNCDT 3300
suppliers.role: Bench gap-sensor reference; range/start offset and steel/field/temperature calibration require selection
suppliers.origin: UK supply available; UK manufacture not evidenced
suppliers.evidence: Manufacturer manual gives sensor-dependent ranges; a 2 mm-range probe cannot cover the 3–13 mm study envelope.

suppliers.name: TI sensored FOC reference
suppliers.origin: Technical reference; no purchasing or local-content credit
suppliers.evidence: Primary reference describes phase-current sensing and dq/PI field-oriented control. It does not qualify the OSR linear motor.
